info.title: OFFER-HUB Orchestrator API
info.description: Generated from the real orchestrator controllers and DTOs - see scripts/openapi-source-data.ts and scripts/README.md for how.

servers.description: Production - replace the placeholder with your deployed orchestrator domain

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: API keys, user registration, wallet challenges, sessions, and OAuth authentication.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Marketplace user provisioning and profile management.

tags.name: Wallet
tags.description: Stellar non-custodial wallet connections via Stellar Wallets Kit, transaction tracking, and sandbox claiming.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Order creation, reservation, cancellation, milestones, attachments, and notes.

tags.name: Escrow
tags.description: Trustless Work Soroban escrow creation, funding, and client-side transaction submission.

tags.name: Resolution
tags.description: Client-side signed release, refund, and dispute preparation for escrow contracts.

tags.name: Disputes
tags.description: Participant dispute tracking and self-cancellation. Reasons: NOT_DELIVERED, QUALITY_ISSUE, OTHER.

tags.name: KYC
tags.description: BlindPay KYC compliance and receiver onboarding for LATAM bank off-ramps.

tags.name: Bank Accounts
tags.description: Local bank account management for BlindPay fiat off-ramp payouts in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Colombia.

tags.name: Payouts
tags.description: BlindPay bank off-ramp payouts in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Colombia.

tags.name: Withdrawals
tags.description: Historical withdrawal records and payout transaction auditing.

tags.name: Balance
tags.description: Internal marketplace ledger balances, reservations, reconciliation, and settlement operations.

tags.name: Config & Health
tags.description: Public endpoints for orchestrator configuration and basic health verification.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream for orders, escrow, balance, and payout domain events.
